description: This image displays processed remote sensing imagery, illustrating the visual characteristics of a sand dune landscape for land cover classification. The lower-left portion of the image shows a textured, mottled area composed of shades of green, lime green, and yellow-green, indicative of vegetated and sandy terrain. This area is sharply delineated by a curved, brighter greenish-blue line from a dark blue to black area occupying the top-right, which likely represents water or open sky. A single small, bright yellow-green pixel or point feature is visible near the upper-left edge of the green area, close to the boundary. The image has a blurred quality, suggesting a magnified or illustrative view consistent with examples found in a nomenclature guideline for identifying land cover types such as sand dunes, as seen in contexts like Maspalomas dune or Doñana Natura 2000 site.
